title: Louisiana court restores man's will leaving entire estate to wife after six children challenge it
summary_full: A Louisiana appeals court restored a 2015 will that left a man's entire estate to his wife after six of his nine children challenged its validity. The judges ruled that the children had failed to prove that the document did not meet the state's revised requirements for notarial wills. The case has been sent back to the trial court for further proceedings.
